elevate.title: Elevate
elevate.description: Jump to go up a floor, sneak to go down. Craftable elevators in 16 colors, floor numbers and named floors.
elevate.pitch: Jump to go up a floor, sneak to go down.
points: 16 craftable colors, from wool and an ender pearl
Floor titles, and floor names set in an anvil
Any distance, blocked floors are skipped
elevate.show_alt: Arriving on floor 3 of 6, the library, with the floor title on screen

gallery.title: Elevate
gallery.description: A six-floor glass tower in a river valley at golden hour. Every floor has an elevator: jump to go up, sneak to go down.

gallery.title: Floor 3/6 · Library
gallery.description: One jump from the storage room and you're in the library, with the floor number and its name on screen.

gallery.title: One jump, one floor
gallery.description: Arriving in the lounge. A soft bell and a burst of particles at your feet, and you're upstairs.

gallery.title: Sixteen colors
gallery.description: Every wool color makes its own elevator. Colors only connect to the same color, so shafts can run side by side.

gallery.title: Craft it from wool
gallery.description: Eight wool of one color around an ender pearl. The recipe shows up in the recipe book on its own.

gallery.title: Name your floors
gallery.description: Rename an elevator in an anvil before you place it and the floor carries that name.

gallery.title: Always know where you are
gallery.description: Step onto an elevator and the action bar shows your floor, its name and which way you can go.

gallery.title: Express to the roof
gallery.description: An orange shaft with only two stops goes from the lobby straight to the roof, past every floor in between.

gallery.title: /elevate info
gallery.description: Every floor in the shaft with its height and name, and an arrow where you stand.

gallery.title: Lights on
gallery.description: The same tower after sunset. Elevators work the same day and night, in every world.

reap.title: Reap
reap.description: Right-click to harvest and auto-replant. Hoes reap a whole area in a wave, Fortune works, farmland never gets trampled.
reap.pitch: Right-click to harvest. Swing a hoe to reap the field.
points: Auto-replant using a seed from the drops
Hoes cut up to 7×7 in a wave, Fortune works
reap.show_alt: A netherite hoe reaping a 7 by 7 square of wheat, ring by ring

gallery.title: Reap
gallery.description: A golden wheat field at sunset, half harvested and replanted in neat rows. One right-click instead of breaking, collecting and replanting.

gallery.title: The harvest wave
gallery.description: A netherite hoe sweeps a 7×7 square of wheat. The crops are cut ring by ring, spreading out from where you clicked.

gallery.title: Planted again, on the spot
gallery.description: Every harvested crop is replanted at once with a little sparkle. One seed comes out of the drops, so your inventory stays untouched.

gallery.title: +36 crops
gallery.description: The action bar sums up every harvest: how many crops were cut and what dropped. A Fortune III hoe brings in extra seeds and carrots.

gallery.title: Every crop
gallery.description: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa on the jungle tree, sugar cane and cactus. Everything on this farm is harvested with a right-click.

gallery.title: Sugar cane, cactus and bamboo
gallery.description: One swing of the hoe cuts every column in reach above the bottom block, so the whole row grows straight back.

gallery.title: No more trampling
gallery.description: A cow, sheep and a pig dropped right onto bare farmland, and it stays farmland. Players can't trample it either.

gallery.title: /reap stats and toggle
gallery.description: Every player can see how many crops they have harvested and switch right-click harvesting off for themselves.

lounge.title: Lounge
lounge.description: Sit on stairs, slabs and carpets, /sit, /lay with your own skin, /crawl and ride other players.
points: Sit on any stair, slab or carpet
`/lay` with your own skin, `/crawl` through gaps
lounge.show_alt: Players sitting on stair benches around a campfire at sunset

gallery.title: Take a seat
gallery.description: Friends gathered around a campfire at sunset. Right-click any stair with an empty hand and you sit on the step, facing away from the backrest.

gallery.title: Stairs, slabs, carpets
gallery.description: A picnic on a carpet next to a slab bench. Every stair, slab and carpet works out of the box, and you can add your own blocks in one line.

gallery.title: Lie down anywhere
gallery.description: `/lay` stretches you out in the grass as a mannequin wearing your own skin, armor and held items. No ProtocolLib, no fake players in the tab list.

gallery.title: Squeeze through
gallery.description: `/crawl` puts you in the swimming pose on land, so you fit through 1-block gaps. Everyone sees it and your hitbox really shrinks.

gallery.title: Ride your friends
gallery.description: Right-click a player to sit on their head. The one at the bottom sneaks to throw everyone off, and `/lounge toggle` opts you out.

gallery.title: Made to fit
gallery.description: Lounge measures how your Minecraft version positions riders, so the body rests exactly on the step on 1.20 and on 26.x alike.
